basis: Placeholder (ASM-SPENDOUT-NEW, DEC-2026-11-12-11): spend-out of new budget authority for a new nondefense program that needs new rules or delivery infrastructure (grants, payments or capital paid to or through states, localities or other outside recipients). Central: the average of CBO's two estimates for laws made mostly of new or sharply expanded nondefense programs, ARRA division A (cost estimate of the conference agreement, February 13, 2009: $311.2B of budget authority, cumulative 11/47/71/84/91% by year 1-5) and IIJA division J (cost estimate of Senate Amendment 2137 to H.R. 3684, August 9, 2021, Table 1: one tranche's shares backed out of five, 9/26/45/63/80%), rounded: 10% in year 1, 36% by year 2, 58% by year 3. Five years, because the model's years start in FY2026, four before the first outlays; the 14% the two estimates spend after year 5 is brought into years 4 and 5, so the shares sum to one. Slow end: IIJA. Fast end: an established program, the data layer's nondefense average (spendout-discretionary-cbo.csv, OMB FY1993-2019 timing, 25/60/90/100%). Cited, not saved
